title: Use Inferlo's AI inside a Hono app
prompt: Create src/hono.ts for an existing Hono app. Export `hono`, a Hono app whose handlers get the AI client from the context as c.var.ai, put there by Inferlo's Hono middleware. The AI client uses an Anthropic provider (API key from the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable) with a "fast" alias for anthropic:claude-haiku-4-5. Add POST /translate to the Hono app: it reads { "text": string, "to": string } from the JSON body, asks the "fast" model to translate the text into that language, and returns { "translation": <the model's text> }. Also mount the existing Inferlo app from src/app.ts under /api, so GET /api/health reaches its health endpoint.
